::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
UMC's mainland 200mm fab (Fab 8N) — established 2001-11, production since May 2003, controlled by UMC since March 2013; a rare Taiwan-controlled fab operating on mainland soil, and still running at high utilization per UMC's mid-2025 statements, raising prices with the 8-inch cycle in 2026. A planned STAR IPO (filed March 2019) was withdrawn July 2019 over control-chain questions; a frequently repeated 'sold to a local group in 2018' claim found NO supporting source and is not adopted here.
:::

**Chinese name:** 和舰芯片制造（苏州）股份有限公司 (Héjiàn Xīnpiàn Zhìzào (Sūzhōu))

## What does this facility make?

Mature-node analog/power/flash wafers on 200mm for UMC's customer base from mainland China.

## Why does it matter?

One of the few cross-strait manufacturing assets still intact as of 2026 — alongside UMC Xiamen (联芯) — its continued high utilization and 10-15% 2026 price actions show Taiwan's mature-node operations remain commercially embedded in the mainland cluster.
